description: Classification-only logical-document splitting for the lab's synthetic insurance packets.

id_document.description: The lab's identity-like demo card with named holder, portrait and membership identifier. This synthetic membership card demonstrates ID field extraction, not government-ID authenticity. Exclude invoice, tax and repair documents.

tax_1099a.description: An IRS Form 1099-A Acquisition or Abandonment of Secured Property, including fictional borrower-copy examples. Exclude other tax forms and prose references.

repair_estimate.description: A standalone repair workshop estimate or quote with vehicle details and proposed repair work. Keep continuation pages of the same estimate together; split a different estimate even if adjacent. Exclude towing/rental/glass invoices and their supporting inspection supplements even when they mention a proposed repair schedule.

other.description: Each distinct supporting document: policy declarations/endorsements, claim intake forms, incident reports, handwritten statements, towing/rental/glass invoices with their own continuation supplements, valuation/downtime schedules, and workshop inspection records. Identify logical boundaries even when adjacent documents both have category other. Keep paginated continuation pages together; do not merge different document titles or identifiers. These documents are unrouted, not discarded.
